methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 real, independently re-verified hedge trimmer models spanning gas, battery, and corded power sources, selected for high US search volume and market relevance as of mid-2026. Primary sources are official manufacturer product pages (EGO, DeWalt, Milwaukee, Makita, Stihl USA, Echo USA, Husqvarna, Ryobi, Greenworks, Black+Decker, Sun Joe, Worx) supplemented by major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Amazon, Target, Acme Tools, Cooper Electric) and independent reviews (Pro Tool Reviews). Blade length and cutting capacity are in inches; weight is in pounds (bare tool unless the manufacturer publishes only a with-battery figure, noted per product); dual_action_blades and rotating_handle are booleans (true=confirmed present, false=confirmed absent, null=not determinable); engine_cc_or_voltage carries the relevant power spec. Prices are published MSRP or current US retail re-verified at the cited source. Adversarial fact-check corrections in this pass: Black+Decker BEHTS300 price 69->79 (Home Depot current, was $99 MSRP); Ryobi RY40610A price 149->169 and manufacturer source replaced (the original ryobitools URL resolves to the RY40620 successor); Greenworks HT40B210 weight 8.3->5.8 lb (Greenworks spec 2.63 kg, tool only; 8.3 lb was an unverifiable third-party figure likely with battery); Worx WG284 rotating_handle false->true (Worx confirms 180-degree head rotation). All accessedAt and generatedAt set to 2026-06-20.

products.name: EGO Power+ HT2410 24" Brushless Hedge Trimmer
products.priceNote: Bare tool, sold without battery/charger; kit with 2.5 Ah battery ~$249
products.provenance: Blade length (24 in), 1 in cut capacity, 56V, dual-action hardened-steel reciprocating blades, and 3000 SPM confirmed on EGO's official product page. 5-position rotating rear handle and ~6.2 lb bare-tool weight confirmed via retailer specs and a 2026 hands-on review (thetestedhub.com lists 7.6 lb WITH battery). Bare-tool price of $169 confirmed at Lowe's listing.

products.name: DeWalt DCHT820B 20V MAX 22" Cordless Hedge Trimmer
products.priceNote: Bare tool; current retail roughly $163-$172 at major retailers
products.provenance: Blade length (22 in) and 3/4 in cut capacity confirmed on DeWalt's official page (listed as discontinued but in active retail). Bare-tool weight 7.8 lb, 2800 SPM, and dual-action (vibration-minimizing) hooked-tooth blade confirmed via Pro Tool Reviews and retailer specs. No rotating handle in any source. Price ~$169 confirmed via retailer listings.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 2726-20 24" Cordless Hedge Trimmer
products.priceNote: Bare tool; ~$296.76 at Cooper Electric, promos run lower (~$248)
products.provenance: Blade length (24 in), 3/4 in cut capacity, 3400 SPM, all-metal gear case, and M18 18V confirmed on Milwaukee's product page. Bare-tool weight 8.6 lb confirmed across distributor specs. No rotating handle in any source. Price ~$296.76 verified at Cooper Electric (corroboration URL replaced; prior rshughes link was blocked and its slug mislabeled a 16 in figure).

products.name: Makita XHU07Z 18V LXT Brushless 24" Cordless Hedge Trimmer
products.priceNote: Bare tool MSRP; kit with two 5 Ah batteries ~$389

Bare-tool MSRP $249 confirmed via multiple retailers.

products.name: Stihl HSA 60 Battery Powered Hedge Trimmer
products.priceNote: Unit only (bare tool, no battery/charger), $329.99 per Stihl USA
products.provenance: Unit-only price $329.99, 36V AK system (40V max/36V rated), rotating multifunction handle (90-degree left/right), and double-sided diamond-ground blades confirmed on Stihl USA page. Blade length (60 cm / ~24 in), 16 mm (~5/8 in) cut capacity, and 7.7 lb weight confirmed via Stihl spec data and Arco Lawn Equipment.

products.name: Husqvarna 122HD45 Gas Hedge Trimmer
products.priceNote: MSRP $249.95 per Husqvarna's US online store; some dealers list ~$299.99

Cut capacity 4/5 in (0.8 in) per Husqvarna description. Official US store (shop.husqvarna.com) confirms $249.95. Listed as discontinued on the main US site but still sold by dealers in 2025-2026.

SAWBLADE tip cuts to ~1.5 in. CORRECTED: price 69->79 (Home Depot current price is $79, previously $99; the $69 figure could not be confirmed).
